cuuint32_t.doc: Unsigned 32-bit integer in the CUDA driver ABI.

cuuint64_t.doc: Unsigned 64-bit integer in the CUDA driver ABI.

__BindgenBitfieldUnit.doc: Byte storage for C bitfields, with accessors that follow the target's bit order.

new.doc: Wraps the supplied storage without changing its bytes.

get_bit.doc:
Reads one bit using the native target's bit order within each byte.

# Panics

Panics if `index / 8` is outside the backing byte slice.

set_bit.doc:
Sets one bit using the native target's bit order within each byte. Other bits remain unchanged.

# Panics

Panics if `index / 8` is outside the backing byte slice.

get.doc:
Reads an unsigned field of up to 64 bits from the backing byte slice. Bit order follows the native target.

# Panics

Panics for an out-of-bounds byte access. Debug assertions also reject widths above 64, an initial offset outside storage, or a field extending beyond storage. Adding the offset and width can panic if arithmetic overflow checks are enabled.

set.doc:
Writes the low `bit_width` bits of `val` into the backing byte slice. Other bits remain unchanged. Bit order follows the native target.

# Panics

Panics for an out-of-bounds byte access. Debug assertions also reject widths above 64, an initial offset outside storage, or a field extending beyond storage. Adding the offset and width can panic if arithmetic overflow checks are enabled.

raw_get_bit.doc:
Reads a bit directly from the inline memory representation of `Storage`.

# Safety

`this` must point to a live bitfield unit, and `index / 8` must select an initialized byte within its storage. The byte must remain readable and must not be modified concurrently during the call.

# Panics

In debug builds, panics if the byte index is outside `Storage`.

raw_set_bit.doc:
Writes a bit directly into the inline memory representation of `Storage`. Other bits remain unchanged.

# Safety

`this` must point to a live bitfield unit, and `index / 8` must select an initialized, writable byte within its storage. Access must be exclusive for that byte during the call. The resulting representation must remain valid for `Storage`.

# Panics

In debug builds, panics if the byte index is outside `Storage`.

raw_get.doc:
Reads up to 64 bits directly from the inline memory representation of `Storage`. Bit order follows the native target.

# Safety

`this` must point to a live bitfield unit. The selected bit range must fit in its storage, contain initialized bytes, and remain readable without concurrent modification during the call. `bit_width` must not exceed 64, and adding it to `bit_offset` must not overflow.

# Panics

Debug assertions reject a width above 64, an initial offset outside storage, or a field extending beyond storage.

raw_set.doc:
Writes the low `bit_width` bits of `val` directly into the inline memory representation of `Storage`. Other bits remain unchanged.

# Safety

`this` must point to a live bitfield unit. The selected bit range must fit in its storage and contain initialized, writable bytes. Access must be exclusive for those bytes during the call, and the resulting representation must remain valid for `Storage`. `bit_width` must not exceed 64, and adding it to `bit_offset` must not overflow.

# Panics

Debug assertions reject a width above 64, an initial offset outside storage, or a field extending beyond storage.

__BindgenUnionField.doc:
Zero-sized marker for one member of a bindgen-emulated C union.

The containing record provides the backing bytes shared by all union members. Constructing a marker alone does not allocate or initialize storage for `T`.

new.doc: Creates the zero-sized field marker without initializing any union storage.

as_ref.doc:
Borrows the backing union bytes as this member type.

# Safety

The marker address must identify backing storage of at least `size_of::<T>()` bytes, aligned for `T`, that contains a valid initialized `T`. The bytes must remain readable and must not be mutated for the returned reference lifetime, except through interior mutability permitted by `T`.

as_mut.doc:
Borrows the backing union bytes mutably as this member type.

# Safety

The marker address must identify backing storage of at least `size_of::<T>()` bytes, aligned for `T`, that contains a valid initialized `T`. The caller must hold exclusive access to all bytes covered by the returned reference for its lifetime, including storage shared with other union members.

cublasGetCudartVersion.doc: Returns the encoded CUDA runtime version against which the cuBLAS library was built.
cublasGetCudartVersion.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasXerbla.doc: Reports an invalid BLAS argument, identifying the routine with `srName` and the argument position with `info`.
cublasXerbla.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasDotcEx.doc: Computes the conjugated dot product of `x` and `y`, conjugating `x`. Input representations, result representation, and execution precision are selected separately. Returns a cuBLAS status code.
cublasDotcEx.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasCopyEx.doc: Copies `n` strided elements from `x` to `y`, with the input and output representations selected by `xType` and `yType`. Returns a cuBLAS status code.
cublasCopyEx.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasSwapEx.doc: Exchanges `n` strided elements of `x` and `y`, using their explicit native data types. Returns a cuBLAS status code.
cublasSwapEx.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasIamaxEx.doc: Writes the one-based index of the first element of maximum absolute value in the strided vector `x`. Complex magnitudes use the sum of the absolute real and imaginary components. Input and index result types are explicit. Returns a cuBLAS status code.
cublasIamaxEx.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasIaminEx.doc: Writes the one-based index of the first element of minimum absolute value in the strided vector `x`. Complex magnitudes use the sum of the absolute real and imaginary components. Input and index result types are explicit. Returns a cuBLAS status code.
cublasIaminEx.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasAsumEx.doc: Writes the sum of absolute values of `n` strided elements of `x`. For complex values, sums the absolute real and imaginary components. Input, result, and execution types are selected separately. Returns a cuBLAS status code.
cublasAsumEx.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasRotgEx.doc: Constructs a Givens plane rotation from `a` and `b` and writes its cosine and sine to `c` and `s`. The first input is overwritten with the rotated magnitude; for real inputs, the second input is also overwritten with the native auxiliary rotation value. Data representations and execution type are explicit. Returns a cuBLAS status code.
cublasRotgEx.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasRotmEx.doc: Applies the modified Givens rotation described by `param` to `n` strided pairs from `x` and `y`, updating both vectors. Data representations and execution type are explicit. Returns a cuBLAS status code.
cublasRotmEx.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasRotmgEx.doc: Constructs a modified Givens rotation from `d1`, `d2`, `x1`, and `y1`, updating `d1`, `d2`, and `x1` and writing the rotation parameters to `param`. Native data types and execution type are explicit. Returns a cuBLAS status code.
cublasRotmgEx.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasCgemm3mEx.doc: Computes a single-precision complex matrix product using the three-real-multiplication algorithm: `C = alpha * op(A) * op(B) + beta * C`. Operands use column-major storage with explicit leading dimensions and data-type selectors. Returns a cuBLAS status code.
cublasCgemm3mEx.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasCgemm3mBatched.doc: Computes a batch of single-precision complex matrix products with the three-real-multiplication algorithm. Device pointer arrays select each matrix, and all products share the dimensions, operations, leading dimensions, `alpha`, and `beta`. Each product updates `C = alpha * op(A) * op(B) + beta * C`. Returns a cuBLAS status code.
cublasCgemm3mBatched.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

cublasCgemm3mStridedBatched.doc: Computes a strided batch of single-precision complex matrix products with the three-real-multiplication algorithm. Each batch updates `C = alpha * op(A) * op(B) + beta * C`; fixed element strides select successive matrices. Returns a cuBLAS status code.
cublasCgemm3mStridedBatched.source: cublas_api.h; cuBLAS Level-1 and Level-3 reference

CUDSS_ALLOCATOR_NAME_LEN.doc: Byte capacity of the inline device-memory-handler name, including its terminating NUL.

name.doc: Null-terminated name of the installed device memory allocator.

cudssCommRankHost.doc: Host-communication callback that writes the calling process rank in `comm` to `rank`.

cudssCommSizeHost.doc: Host-communication callback that writes the process count in `comm` to `size`.

cudssSendHost.doc: Sends `count` elements of `datatype` to rank `dest` using `tag` and `comm`.

cudssRecvHost.doc: Receives `count` elements of `datatype` from the selected source rank and tag into `buffer`.

cudssBcastHost.doc: Broadcasts `count` elements from `root` to the other ranks of `comm`.

cudssReduceHost.doc: Reduces `count` elements with `op` and stores the result at `root`.

cudssAllreduceHost.doc: Reduces `count` elements with `op` and stores the result on every rank.

cudssScattervHost.doc: Scatters variable element counts from `root`, using per-rank counts and displacements in the send buffer.

cudssCommSplitHost.doc: Creates a host-communication subgroup selected by `color` and ordered by `key`, writing it to `newcomm`.

cudssCommFreeHost.doc: Releases a host-communication communicator created by the communication layer.

cudss_thr_func_t.doc: Callback executing one task index with the caller-provided context in the cuDSS parallel-for interface.

cutensorMpAlgo_t.doc: Algorithm selector for distributed multi-process tensor operations.

cutensorMpPlanAttribute_t.doc: Plan attributes reporting required device or host workspace bytes as `uint64_t` values.

cutensorMpTensorDescriptorAttribute_t.doc: Attributes describing a tensor's mode count and the calling rank's realized local shape and storage.

cutensorMpHandle_t.doc: Opaque context for tensor operations distributed over an NCCL communicator, a local CUDA device, and a stream.

NVJPEG_CSS_440.doc: Chroma has the luma width and half its height.

channel.doc: Device pointers to image planes; the selected input or output format determines which entries are used and their channel ordering.

dev_malloc.doc: Context-aware callback allocating device storage for nvJPEG.

cusparseSpSV_analysis.doc: Analyzes the sparse triangular system for a vector right-hand side and stores reusable solve state in the solve descriptor. cusparseSpSV_solve.doc: Solves the previously analyzed sparse triangular system for a vector right-hand side. Use the solve descriptor initialized by `cusparseSpSV_analysis` and keep its matrix structure, compatible options, and workspace valid. `alpha` scales the right-hand side.
cusparseSpSV_solve.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpSV_updateMatrix.doc: Updates an analyzed triangular-solve descriptor with matrix values from `newValues`. `updatePart` selects a complete value update or a diagonal-only update; the analyzed sparsity pattern remains unchanged.

cusparseSpSM_analysis.doc: Analyzes the sparse triangular system for a dense matrix of right-hand sides and stores reusable solve state in the solve descriptor. cusparseSpSM_analysis.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpSM_solve.doc: Solves the previously analyzed sparse triangular system for a dense matrix of right-hand sides. Use the solve descriptor initialized by `cusparseSpSM_analysis` and keep its matrix structure, compatible options, and workspace valid. `alpha` scales the right-hand side.
cusparseSpSM_solve.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpSM_updateMatrix.doc: Updates an analyzed triangular-solve descriptor with matrix values from `newValues`. `updatePart` selects a complete value update or a diagonal-only update; the analyzed sparsity pattern remains unchanged.
cusparseSpSM_updateMatrix.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseDenseToSparse_analysis.doc: Analyzes a dense matrix to determine the stored-entry count of the destination sparse descriptor. Query workspace first; allocate and attach the destination sparse index and value arrays before calling `cusparseDenseToSparse_convert`.

cusparseDenseToSparse_convert.doc: Writes sparse indices and values for the dense input using the structure determined by `cusparseDenseToSparse_analysis`. The caller must allocate and attach the destination sparse arrays before conversion.
cusparseDenseToSparse_convert.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpMV_preprocess.doc: Optionally preprocesses a sparse matrix for subsequent matrix-vector products. The resulting active buffer is associated with the sparse descriptor; preserve that buffer and the sparsity pattern and follow the native parameter-reuse constraints for subsequent `cusparseSpMV` calls.
cusparseSpMV_preprocess.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpMM_preprocess.doc: Optionally preprocesses a sparse matrix for subsequent sparse-dense matrix products. The resulting active buffer is associated with the sparse descriptor; preserve that buffer and the sparsity pattern and follow the native parameter-reuse constraints for subsequent `cusparseSpMM` calls.
cusparseSpMM_preprocess.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSDDMM_preprocess.doc: Preprocesses the sampled dense-dense matrix multiplication described by the matrix descriptors, operations, compute type, and algorithm. Provide the temporary device buffer sized by `cusparseSDDMM_bufferSize` and use compatible parameters in the subsequent computation.
cusparseSDDMM_preprocess.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpGEMM_workEstimation.doc: Queries workspace or estimates the intermediate work for sparse matrix multiplication, retaining phase state in `spgemmDescr`. A null `externalBuffer1` queries `bufferSize1` in bytes. With workspace supplied, this phase computes information used by subsequent phases; retain that buffer through `cusparseSpGEMM_compute`.
cusparseSpGEMM_workEstimation.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpGEMM_getNumProducts.doc: Writes the number of intermediate scalar products determined by `cusparseSpGEMM_workEstimation` to the host output `num_prods`.
cusparseSpGEMM_getNumProducts.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpGEMM_estimateMemory.doc: Queries or estimates the memory required by the selected sparse multiplication algorithm. `bufferSize3` describes estimation scratch storage and `bufferSize2` describes computation workspace, both in bytes. `chunk_fraction` controls chunking for algorithm 3.
cusparseSpGEMM_estimateMemory.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpGEMM_compute.doc: Queries computation workspace or computes intermediate sparse matrix products using state from the preceding work-estimation phase. `bufferSize2` is in bytes. The resulting state is finalized into the caller's output arrays by `cusparseSpGEMM_copy`; retain the computation workspace through that copy.
cusparseSpGEMM_compute.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpGEMM_copy.doc: Finalizes sparse matrix multiplication by writing the computed structure and values to the arrays attached to `matC`. Complete the work-estimation and compute phases first, then allocate and attach output arrays using the reported nonzero count before this call.
cusparseSpGEMM_copy.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpGEMMreuse_copy.doc: Queries copy workspace or transfers the reusable sparse multiplication structure into the output matrix arrays after the reusable nonzero-count phase. `bufferSize5` is a byte count. The retained descriptor state supports later value computations with the same sparsity patterns.
cusparseSpGEMMreuse_copy.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpGEMMreuse_compute.doc: Computes new sparse matrix-product values using the structure retained by the preceding reusable SpGEMM setup phases. Uses `alpha` and `beta` to scale the product and existing output; the input and output sparsity patterns must match the retained state.
cusparseSpGEMMreuse_compute.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpMMOp_createPlan.doc: Creates and compiles a sparse-dense matrix multiplication plan using the supplied addition, multiplication, and epilogue device operators in LTO IR. Writes the plan to `plan` and its workspace byte count to `SpMMWorkspaceSize`. Release the plan with `cusparseSpMMOp_destroyPlan`.
cusparseSpMMOp_createPlan.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references

cusparseSpMMOp_destroyPlan.doc: Releases the compiled kernel and native resources owned by a custom sparse-dense multiplication plan.
cusparseSpMMOp_destroyPlan.source: cuSPARSE 12.8.6.72 cusparse.h; CUDA 13.4.2 cuSPARSE legacy and generic API references
